stem: Why is irrigation frequency usually more defensible when based on measured depletion than on a fixed clock alone?
choices: Measured depletion reflects changing plant and root-zone conditions that a fixed schedule may miss
Clock schedules automatically measure root oxygen
Fixed times guarantee identical water use every day
Depletion is unrelated to plant development
rationale: Crop water use varies with plant size, environment and substrate state. Depletion-based feedback can reveal when a previously suitable schedule no longer matches conditions.
